title: QC - Councils, Committees & Partnerships - 004 - Business Council Membership Request
description:
FRONTEND — Visitor Display & Form Submission
User
Story ID: QC-004 | US-029 | REF: FR-029
Title: Business Council Membership Request — Visitor Display & Form
Submission
As a public website visitor
I want to access the Business
Council Membership Request page, review information about business councils,
and submit a request to join
So that I can formally apply to
participate in a Qatar Chamber business council
Preconditions
- The Qatar Chamber website is published and accessible.
- The Business Council Membership Request page is
published in the CMS.
- The Business Council Membership Request form is active
and visible.
- Country values are loaded from the system master
country list.
What the Visitor Sees
- Breadcrumb (Home › Councils, Committees &
Partnerships), and a hero banner titled “Business Council Membership Request”
with the subtitle “Select the country’s most relevant to your company and
submit a request for review by Qatar Chamber's Committee & Business
Councils Department.”
- An informational section with the eyebrow “Business
Councils,” the heading “Connect with Global Business Partners,” and body copy
describing the purpose of business councils, member benefits, and the
application process.
- A form card titled “Business Council Membership
Request” with an icon and the helper text “Fields marked with * are required.
Country 1 represents your highest priority. Submission confirms receipt for
review and does not confirm membership.”
- Three labeled field groups: “Country Priorities”
(Country 1–4, all required, ranked by priority), “Applicant & Company”
(Applicant Name, Company Name, CR Number, Owner Name), and “Contact &
Activity” (Email, Mobile Number, Telephone, Fax, Website, Company Activity).
- A consent line above the Submit button: “By submitting,
you confirm that the information provided is accurate and may be used to review
this request.”
- A “Submit” button with an arrow icon.
Frontend Workflow
- Public Visitor navigates to Main Menu → Councils,
Committees & Partnerships → Business Council Membership Request.
- Page loads displaying the hero, informational content
about business councils, and the Business Council Membership Request form.
- Public Visitor reads the business council information.
- Public Visitor scrolls to the form and selects a
country in each of Country 1–4, ranked by priority (Country 1 = highest
priority).
- Public Visitor fills in all required Applicant &
Company and Contact & Activity fields, including Company Activity.
- Public Visitor completes CAPTCHA and clicks Submit.
- System validates all mandatory fields, including that
all four countries are selected and no validation on duplicates exist across
Country 1–4.
- If validation passes, the system stores the submission
with status Pending.
- On success, the system displays a bilingual
acknowledgement message and sends two emails: A Submission Confirmation to the
applicant and a New Request notification to the admin.
Acceptance Criteria
Given the visitor
opens the Business Council Membership Request page
When
the visitor fills the form and submits
Then:
- the system shall display the hero, the informational
content, and the Business Council Membership Request form.
- all mandatory fields shall be validated with real-time
inline validation.
- all four countries (Country 1–4) must be selected
before submission; none may be left blank.
- duplicate country selections are allowed across Country
1–4.
- country dropdown values shall be populated from the
system master country list (CMS-managed Lookup Table).
- Company Activity shall be a required field, validated
to a maximum length.
- CAPTCHA shall be mandatory and validated before
submission; the form shall not submit if CAPTCHA fails.
- duplicate submission prevention is enforced based on
email + company name.
- on successful submission, the system shall store the
record with status: Pending.
- the system shall display a bilingual acknowledgement
message to the visitor.
- the system shall send a Submission Confirmation email
to the applicant and a New Request Notification email to the admin.
- no email is sent to the applicant at the point of
submission other than the Submission Confirmation — status-change emails are
governed separately by the admin review workflow.
Edge Case Scenarios
- If CAPTCHA fails or is not completed, submission is
blocked.
Negative Scenarios
- Missing mandatory fields trigger real-time inline
validation messages.
Post Condition
Business Council Membership
Request is stored with Pending status. Visitor receives an on-screen
acknowledgement and a confirmation email.
Success Screen — On Form Submission (Visitor)
English:
Your Business Council Membership Request has been submitted
successfully. Your request is currently under review. You will be contacted
once the review is completed.
Arabic:
تم إرسال طلب عضوية مجلس الأعمال بنجاح. طلبكم
الآن قيد المراجعة. سيتم التواصل معكم بعد الانتهاء من المراجعة.
BACKEND — Admin CMS Management & Request Review
User
Story ID: QC -004 | US-029 | REF: FR-029
Title: Business Council Membership Request — CMS Management & Request
Review
As an authorized admin user
(Site Content Editor / Form Manager)
I want to manage the Business
Council Membership Request page content and review, approve, or reject
submitted requests
So that Qatar Chamber can manage
business council membership applications with a clear approval trail
Administrator Workflow
- Site Content Editor logs into Liferay CMS.
- Navigates to the Business Council Membership Request
page.
- Manages page content: hero, informational text (EN |
AR), and page visibility.
- Saves draft, previews, and publishes.
- Form Manager opens the Business Council Membership
Request submissions listing.
- Views submitted applications, each showing status
Pending by default.
- Opens a request to review submitted details.
- Updates the request status to Approved or Rejected: if
Approved, the system sends an Approval email to the applicant; if Rejected, the
admin enters a rejection reason and the system saves the status and reason
internally, sending no email.
- System records the action in the audit log.
Acceptance Criteria
Given the admin
reviews a submitted Business Council Membership Request
When
the admin updates the status
Then:
- the admin can view all submitted requests with their
current status (Pending / Approved / Rejected).
- new submissions default to status: Pending.
- setting status to Approved shall trigger an Approval
email to the applicant.
- setting status to Rejected shall require a rejection
reason before saving, shall store that reason with the record, and shall send
no email to the applicant.
- all submissions are stored for audit and internal
tracking, including the rejection reason where applicable.
- only authorized users (Form Manager / Site Content
Editor) can access submission records.
- the system displays the Liferay generic toast after
each action.
Negative Scenarios
- Publishing without required bilingual page content
triggers validation errors.
- Attempting to set status to Rejected without entering a
rejection reason shall be blocked with a validation error.
Post Condition
Business Council Membership
Request status is updated. The applicant is notified only on Approval; a
Rejected request is closed internally with its reason recorded, with no
applicant notification.

Business Rules
- All mandatory fields, including Company Activity, must
be completed before submission.
- CAPTCHA verification is mandatory and must pass before
form submission.
- Submitted applications are stored with a default status
of Pending for internal review.
- Only Approved status triggers an applicant email
(Approval email); Rejected status sends no email and instead stores the
rejection reason for internal tracking.
